comments.author: toomuchtodo
comments.story: Pakistan says rooftop solar output to exceed grid demand in some hubs next year
comments.why: Listed among references on the solar and battery energy transition.
comments.text: It is unfortunate that the government of Pakistan and their investors (China and the IMF) made poor investment decisions. They should feel free to go back to debt holders to renegotiate the debt, or default on it and hand the stranded assets back to creditors. The death spiral is of their own making, and will only accelerate as solar PV and battery cost declines continue. Electricity consumers will simply go off the grid. Such is the risk of unsophisticated investors not understanding the market in which they invest. Capital being at risk is an inherent component of investment. My condolences and sympathy to the people of Pakistan caught in the mess. The global energy transition will be volatile. Solar electricity every hour of every day is here and it changes everything - [LINK] - June 21st, 2025 Stranded fossil-fuel assets translate to major losses for investors in advanced economies - [LINK] | [LINK] - May 26th, 2022 Rethinking Energy -- 100% Solar, Wind and Batteries Is Just The Beginning - [VIDEO] - January 2021 Who owns the distressed fossil generation collateralized debt? China. Where is Pakistan importing cleantech from? China. There is some IMF debt in there as well, for accuracy.
